items.claim: Target cache ignores the zoom and stroke setting the boxes are measured at
items.note: The cache key now also includes the session's `drawnBox` function. Each session builds a new one at the zoom and stroke setting it began with, so a later gesture measures again. A zoom in the middle of a drag keeps the boxes measured at press, the same zoom the subject's own box was measured at.

items.claim: Two spacing-hints presets given ids both add a `distanceReadout` contribution
items.note: When `id` is given, the readout is now named `<id>.readout`. An explicit `readout.id` still wins.

items.claim: Distance readout measures pose boxes while the spacing snap measures ink boxes
items.note: The readout now measures through the `drawnBoxes` dep, and also requires `boundsIncludeStroke` and `view`.

items.claim: A spanned guide is picked anywhere along the whole line
items.note: `guideAt` now skips a press outside the guide's span, allowing `GUIDE_HIT_PX` past each end. This matches the guides layer's default `extent: 'span'`.

items.claim: Detaching the rulers leaves view, size, pointer and draft in place
items.note: Teardown now resets the state through `set` and notifies subscribers.

items.claim: `moveBy` test helper throws when given a scene but no ids
items.note: The helper isn't exported, so there's no changeset.

items.claim: Rulers' and distance readout's `leave` bindings have no `mods`, so leaving with a key held doesn't clear them
items.note: Both now use `ANY_MODS`. The tests check the binding spec rather than going through `matchSpec`, because guides doesn't depend on `@weasel-js/gestures`.
